propositions: Tickets-store git pack size exceeds CI verification gate limit (131431 KiB > 131072 KiB), requiring coordinated repack/gc and bridge-history rewrite to reclaim ~1 GiB of spent objects and add headroom for stale-base change verification.

Prerequisite bug 30d3-eaf0-c7a4-497a must be closed with all diagnostic repairs complete (zero repairable findings, exactly four intentional STATUS_FORK_RESOLVED records) before history rewrite begins.

History rewrite via git fast-export/filter/fast-import must preserve exact tree, commit count, merge count, and identity multisets while removing .bridge_state.bak-retarget historical commits and keeping final published pack under 150 MiB.

Deterministic first post-rewrite write (re-pin review-bot vote) must be sole canonical four-commit sequence with REBAR_LLM_OVERLAP_DRAIN=off, no old-tip ancestry, and incremental growth below 1 MB before opportunistic enrichment is restored.
